items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So he took his band, it was a trio, it was Lenny McBrown and Hal... Gaylor? And me, and we all got into Paul’s car and we drove to Las Vegas.

ctx.x: So with you and Paul, the relationship was kindled there of course, with… in New York for how long before moving back to L.A.? And what?

Well that was just, Paul Bley wanted to move to LA, I don’t know why. Oh no, I think he went to, he wanted to go to Las Vegas. So he took his band, it was a trio, it was Lenny McBrown and Hal... Gaylor? And me, and we all got into Paul’s car and we drove to Las Vegas. And the gig only lasted two nights, and Paul got fired. So there we were in Las Vegas and we decided to go to California cause it was closer. It’s strange how you just can do anything you want to. You can decide to go North, South, East, West, it’s…
Were you starting to, did you start at that point to write for Paul, or that came once you’re in L.A.?
